title: Tree Scanner
description: The scanner walks source trees for @kaava: markers, language-agnostic.
body: Walks a source tree for `@kaava:` marker tokens. The token is found by plain regular expression per the PRD, and that is taken literally here: every text file's raw content is scanned line by line with the same regex regardless of the file's language. There is no per-language comment parser, which lets an unrecognized language degrade to a plain text scan rather than a miss.
